description: pantheon: a verification gate. On Stop, reads the transcript of the turn trying to finish and refuses it when a check failed, a stub was introduced, or a substantial code change shipped with no verification behind it.

hooks.command: B="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/pantheon/gate"; S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src"; N=$(ls -t "$S"/*.cpp "$S"/*.hpp 2>/dev/null | head -1); if ! { [ -x "$B" ] && [ -n "$N" ] && [ ! "$N" -nt "$B" ]; }; then mkdir -p "${B%/*}"; c++ -std=c++20 -O2 -o "$B" "$S"/*.cpp 2>/dev/null || echo "pantheon: no working C++ compiler on PATH, so the verification gate is inert this session"; fi
